title: Automatically Lanterns
description: Automatic Lanterns is a data pack that dynamically turns lanterns on at night and off during the day, adding a touch of realism and convenience to your world.
body:
--- # **Automatic Lanterns** **Automatic Lanterns** is a data pack that enables lanterns to automatically turn on at night and off during the day, enhancing immersion and convenience in your world.
🛠️ How to Use To activate the **Automatic Lanterns** data pack: 1. Use the `/function give` to obtain the necessary items. 2. Utilize spawn eggs to place automatic lanterns in your world.
🌟 Current Features - 🌙 Lanterns that dynamically toggle based on the time of day. - 🔥 Two different lantern variants (as of update 0). - 🎮 Designed primarily for **Adventure** and **Creative** mode.
🚀 Future Plans - 🛠️ Custom crafting recipes to create different lantern variants. - ⚒️ Improved **Survival** compatibility to make the pack more accessible for all gameplay styles. - 🔥 Support for additional light sources, including: - 🕯️ **Torch** - 🔵 **Soul Torch** - 🏮 **Lantern** - 🔷 **Soul Lantern** - 🏗️ Crafting recipes for each light source to be placed on **every type of wall** as support.
At its current stage, **Automatic Lanterns** is **not yet survival-friendly**, but future updates will introduce crafting recipes and other enhancements to integrate seamlessly into survival worlds. ---
